Különleges csapatunk adja infrastruktúránk erejét! Magyarország legnagyobb és legjobb telco infrastruktúra cégét építjük.
A 2Connectnél hiszünk benne, hogy a legerősebb hálózatokat nem csak technológiával, hanem emberekkel, élményekkel és értékekkel építjük. Működésünket az a mód teszi különlegessé, hogy csak ránk jellemző, különleges módon kapcsolódunk ügyfeleinkhez, feladatainkhoz, önmagunkhoz és egymáshoz. Profi, megoldásközpontú, támogató, összehangolt csapatunk adja valódi erőnket – és ez különböztet meg minket másoktól.
Csatlakozzon hozzánk!
A munkakör célja
A vezetékes infrastruktúra és hálózat, valamint a kapcsolódó szolgáltatások folyamatos felügyeletének szakmai és vezetői irányítása, a szolgáltatásbiztonság fenntartása, az SLA- és KPI-célok teljesítése, valamint az incidensek gyors és következetes kezelése. A szerephez egy körülbelül 15 fős NOC csapat irányítása, munkaszervezése, beosztása, fejlesztése és teljesítményének támogatása tartozik.
A szakmai fókusz a felügyelt vezetékes infrastruktúra teljes láncát lefedi: réz-, optikai és koaxiális hozzáférési hálózatok; GPON/ONT/OLT és HFC/CMTS környezet; edge és core routerek, switchek, IP/MPLS, DNS és DHCP; SDH/DWDM átviteltechnika; valamint a vezetékes hangszolgáltatást biztosító rendszerek és telefonközpontok.
A napi működés vezetése mellett aktív alakítója lesz a 2Connect NOC jövőjének: az egységes, szolgáltatásalapú és automatizált felügyeletnek, az AI-val támogatott működésnek, a hálózatfelügyeleti konszolidációnak és a több partner kiszolgálására alkalmas modellnek. results.descriptionText:
Kik vagyunk? Az Indotek Group Magyarország egyik vezető befektetéskezelő nemzetközi cégcsoportja, amely már 14 országban van aktívan jelen. Tevékenységünk középpontjában az ingatlanokkal fedezett banki követelések, valamint a különböző ipari-, kereskedelmi-, szolgáltatói- és lakáscélú ingatlanok megvásárlását, fejlesztését, üzemeltetését és értékesítését magában foglaló vagyonkezelés áll. A közel 600 főt foglalkoztató Indotek Group tulajdonában lévő ingatlanok száma meghaladja a 350-et, és a cégcsoport piacvezető a magyarországi B és C kategóriás ingatlanok piacán. Portfóliónkba tartozik több, mint 40 irodaház, közel 30 külföldi és hazai bevásárlóközpont, számos szálloda, raktárépület, iparterület. results.descriptionText:
IT Manager (m/f/d) | CAIP Hungary 
 
 CAIP Group is a global Tier 1 automotive supplier for premium interior components — instrument panels, door panels, and decorative trims — for leading European OEMs. As part of our European expansion we are building a new manufacturing facility in Nyíregyháza.
 There is no IT landscape here yet. You will build it: infrastructure, core systems, security architecture, and the local IT organization. What you decide in the first year will run the plant for the next decade.
 
 Your first 18 months 
 Set up plant IT infrastructure from scratch — network, shopfloor connectivity, server and cloud footprint, end-user environment.
 Bring SAP, MES, and WMS live for start of production, integrated with our group systems and with OEM EDI interfaces.
 Establish the security and governance framework required for TISAX assessment and GDPR compliance.
 Build the local IT team and the external partner network that will support 3-shift operation.
 
 Your ongoing responsibilities 
 Systems and operations 
 Own the plant's core business systems — SAP, MES, APS, WMS, SRM, EDI — and their availability during production hours.
 Run IT infrastructure and asset lifecycle: procurement, deployment, maintenance, upgrades, decommissioning.
 Ensure operational continuity for a plant running around the clock, including a defined on-call and escalation model.
 
 Cybersecurity and compliance 
 Define and enforce IT security policies, access control, and data protection standards.
 Run risk assessments, vulnerability testing, and disaster recovery planning — and test the recovery, not just the plan.
 Maintain TISAX and GDPR compliance and lead incident response with internal and external partners.
 
 Digitalization 
 Drive system integration, shopfloor data transparency, and process digitalization in line with the group's Industry 4.0 roadmap.
 Work with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Finance to turn operational problems into IT solutions — not the other way round.
 Feed IT investment priorities into plant and group planning.
 
 Team and partners 
 Build and lead the local IT team; steer external service providers against clear SLAs.
 Manage vendors, integrators, and contracts with a focus on cost and service quality.
 Represent IT in customer audits, OEM assessments, and internal reviews.
 
 Your profile 
 Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Network Engineering, or comparable technical qualification.
 7+ years in IT management in manufacturing, ideally automotive; experience in a greenfield setup or plant ramp-up is a decisive advantage.
 Hands-on knowledge of SAP and manufacturing systems (MES, WMS, APS, SRM) and of OEM EDI communication.
 Solid grounding in infrastructure, OT/IT security, and automotive compliance requirements — TISAX experience strongly preferred.
 Fluent Hungarian and English. Chinese is a clear advantage in daily work with our headquarters.
 Able to operate in a matrix: you set the local direction while working within group IT standards.
 
 What we offer 
 Full ownership of the IT landscape of a new plant — greenfield, not maintenance.
 Direct reporting line to [Plant Manager / Group IT], short decision paths, real budget responsibility.
 Long-term perspective in a fast-growing global Tier 1 organization.
 Competitive package including relocation support

results.descriptionText:
Különleges csapatunk adja infrastruktúránk erejét! Magyarország legnagyobb és legjobb telco infrastruktúra cégét építjük.
A 2Connectnél hiszünk benne, hogy a legerősebb hálózatokat nem csak technológiával, hanem emberekkel, élményekkel és értékekkel építjük. Működésünket az a mód teszi különlegessé, hogy csak ránk jellemző, különleges módon kapcsolódunk ügyfeleinkhez, feladatainkhoz, önmagunkhoz és egymáshoz. Profi, megoldásközpontú, támogató, összehangolt csapatunk adja valódi erőnket – és ez különböztet meg minket másoktól.
Csatlakozzon hozzánk!
A munkakör célja
Az országos mobilhálózat és a kapcsolódó szolgáltatások folyamatos felügyeletének szakmai és vezetői irányítása, a szolgáltatásbiztonság fenntartása, az SLA- és KPI-célok teljesítése, valamint az incidensek gyors és következetes kezelése. A szerephez egy körülbelül 15 fős hálózatfelügyeleti (NOC) csapat irányítása, munkaszervezése, beosztása, fejlesztése és teljesítményének támogatása tartozik.
A szakmai fókusz a felügyelt mobil szolgáltatások teljes láncát lefedi: RAN, mobil adat- és hanghálózati Core, Voice/IMS környezet, értéknövelt szolgáltatások, SMS/MMS és tömeges SMS, IN/prepaid funkciók, hívásátirányítás, számhordozási rendszerek, valamint a kapcsolódó mikrohullámú és átviteltechnikai elemek.
A napi működés vezetése mellett aktív alakítója lesz a 2Connect NOC jövőjének: az egységes, szolgáltatásalapú és automatizált felügyeletnek, az AI-val támogatott működésnek, a hálózatfelügyeleti konszolidációnak és a több partner kiszolgálására alkalmas modellnek. A NOC stratégiájának és fejlesztési irányainak kialakításában is számítunk az új vezetőre!

results.descriptionText:
Description & Requirements
 Who we are looking for
 The IT Service Associate Manager ensures the efficient and effective delivery of IT services within the organization. Acting as a key liaison between technology and business teams, the IT Service Associate Manager focuses on maintaining seamless service operations in the areas of Incident Management, Major Incident Management, and Service Request Fulfillment.
This role requires a balance of leadership, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills to ensure services meet established standards and customer expectations. Continuous improvement of processes, fostering collaboration, and ensuring adherence to ITIL best practices are central to this position.
 Your skillset
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 German and English at minimum B2 level (very good written and spoken skills) to collaborate with demanding target groups.
 Proactive and structured approach to problem-solving. Crisis management and decision-making capabilities.
 Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or a comparable field, with several years of relevant professional experience in Service Management.
 Solid knowledge of common standards and methodologies in ITIL-based Service Management within complex organizations.
 Practical experience in active Service Management of central ITSM processes such as Incident/Problem/Request Management and a strong understanding of processes.
 Knowledge and efficient usage of ServiceNow and MS PowerBI (or alternative platforms)
 Structured and independent working style, ownership mentality, creativity, and an agile mindset, along with organizational skills and the ability to work in interdisciplinary teams.
 Your future role
 Your responsibilities
 Ensure timely resolution of incidents and escalations, minimizing business impact and coordinating cross-functional teams as needed.
 Lead responses to major incidents, ensuring clear communication, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive measures.
 Oversee efficient service request fulfillment, driving process improvements and automation where possible.
 Ensure compliance with ITIL processes, organizational standards, and audit requirements.
 Collaborate with IT Operations, Engineering, and stakeholders to maintain service integration. Collaborate with team leads and management to align service goals with business objectives.
 Identify and implement service optimizations by analyzing KPIs and enhancing user experience.
 Maintain accurate process documentation and promote knowledge sharing within the team.
 Act decisively during crises to restore normal operations and minimize disruptions.
 Your activities
 Conduct regular status reviews of incident and service request queues, initiating corrective actions when necessary.
 Facilitate post-incident reviews and document lessons learned.
 Lead training and awareness sessions on incident and service request processes for team members.
 Support the onboarding of new employees, ensuring they understand service management workflows.
 Monitor Service Desk performance metrics (e.g., response times, resolution rates). Analyze patterns and trends of outages and disruptions (e.g., root cause analysis) to identify potential future issues and ensure continuous service availability.
 What we offer
 Stable job in multinational company based on employment contract;
 Working in flexible hybrid model - partially from home and the office;
 Great opportunity for professional development;
 Structured onboarding process and Buddy program for new joiners;
 Open and friendly organizational culture based on the pillars of well-being and diversity & inclusion.
 Selection process
 Apply and create your future with us!
If your resume is of interest to us, the recruitment will consist of several stages:
 Short online interview / short phone interview with Recruiter.
 Interview/s with member/s of the team.
 You will receive feedback regardless of process result.

results.descriptionText:
A BKM BUDAPESTI KÖZMŰVEK Nonprofit Zrt. 
 Fejlesztési és beruházási igazgatósága munkatársat keres  
 BERUHÁZÁSI PROJEKTMENEDZSER 
 munkakörbe 
   
  
 Kik vagyunk mi? 
   
 Mi a BKM Nonprofit Zrt.-ben a fővárosunkért és annak lakóiért dolgozunk – nap mint nap. Jelen vagyunk a lakosok mindennapi életében; ellátjuk a köztisztasági, a távhőszolgáltatási, a kertészeti, a temetkezési, a dísz- és közvilágítási feladatokat, valamint országos szinten kéményseprőipari szolgáltatásokat nyújtunk. 
 Csatlakozz hozzánk Budapest fejlődéséért! 
   
   
    Miért jó nálunk dolgozni?  
 ·       egy közművállalat biztonságát és kiszámíthatóságát nyújtjuk
 ·       látványos projektekben veszel részt
 ·       a saját műszaki projektjeid valósulnak meg, és Te leszel a középpontban
 ·       felfedezheted a legújabb technológiákat, amik más cégeknél nem elérhetők
 ·       fővárosi projektekben veszel részt, ezért nincs állandó utazás országon belül
 ·       a betanulási időszakot követően feladataidtól függően akár heti 1 napot home office-ban is dolgozhatsz
 ·       itt nem hagy a csapat magadra, ha úgy érzed elakadtál
 ·       számos béren kívüli juttatásban részesülhetsz (pl. SZÉP-kártya, egészség- vagy nyugdíjpénztári tagdíj hozzájárulás, óvodai, bölcsődei étkeztetés elszámolása, balesetbiztosítás a munkába állás napjától)
 ·       a jó teljesítményt anyagilag is elismerjük: negyedévente a teljesítményedtől függően pénzbeli juttatást kaphatsz
 ·       rendszeres képzések és tréningek segítik a szakmai fejlődésedet
      Milyen feladatok várnak? 
 ·       projekt koordináció: te irányítod a beruházási folyamatokat a projekt előkészítésétől a megvalósulásig
 ·       ellenőrzés: folyamatosan figyelemmel kíséred az alvállalkozók munkáját, és irányítod a projekteket
 ·       költség- és ütemtervek készítése: létrehozod és vezeted a nyilvántartásokat
 ·       dokumentáció: te archiválod a projektekkel kapcsolatos dokumentumokat, így minden mindig rendben lesz
    Mit várunk a munkakör betöltéséhez? 
 ·       rendelkezz műszaki diplomával (gépészmérnöki végzettség előnyt jelent)
 ·       legyen legalább 5 év tapasztalatod 
 ·       kifejezetten erős kommunikációs képességeket (szóban és írásban is)
 ·       ismerd az iparági szabályrendszert, mozogj otthonosan a műszaki rajzok ellenőrzésében
 ·       legyél cél- és eredményorientált és rendelkezz erős vezetői attitűddel
 ·       irányítsd határozottan a szerződött partnereket, beszállítókat (határidők, költségek, megfelelő minőség, szerződéses feltételek követése, ellenőrzése)
 ·       legyél csapatjátékos, tudj hatékonyan együttműködni más szervezetek kollégáival is
 ·       vállald a munkáddal járó felelősséget és kezeld magabiztosan a felmerülő problémákat és konfliktusokat
 ·       legyél proaktív, ismerd fel előre a döntési pontokat és időben tájékoztasd róla vezetőidet
 ·       legyen rálátásod a közbeszerzési eljárásokra
 ·       mozogj otthonosan az erősen szabályozott vállalati környezetben és folyamatokban
 ·       rendelkezz erős adminisztratív és IT kompetenciával (projektirányítási, riportálási, dokumentációs stb. rendszerek magabiztos használata)
 ·       "B" kategóriás jogosítványt, vezetési rutint
 
 Munkavégzés helye: 1116 Budapest, Kalotaszeg utca 31.
      
     Ha tetszett az álláshirdetés, várjuk jelentkezésedet!

results.descriptionText:
Company Description
 As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.
DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.
 Job Description
 Our Security Implementation & Business Integration Division plays a pivotal role in strengthening group‑wide security governance and enabling secure business operations across the entire organization. As part of this team, you will contribute to:
 Driving and enforcing security governance standards across the Group
 Managing the Security Business Partner Program to achieve strategic security objectives
 Supporting business units with processes, procedures, and tools that enhance security maturity
 Overseeing the implementation and documentation of security requirements through KPIs, reporting, audits, and certifications throughout the value chain
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the security landscape of a global organization by:
 Implementing and enforcing group‑wide security governance standards across the organization
 Managing the Security Business Partner Program to support strategic security objectives
 Providing expert consulting and support to business units on security processes, procedures, and tools
 Overseeing the implementation and documentation of security requirements through KPIs, reporting, audits, and certifications
 Implementing and managing ISMS reference methodologies and procedures in line with Group guidelines, both at Group‑level and for individual units
 Supporting the maintenance, continuous improvement, and operational execution of ISMS requirements across the Telekom Group (e.g., supplier management)
 Defining requirements for tools used in security and privacy processes and coordinating their technical implementation
 Preparing, supporting, and conducting internal and external security audits (ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 27701, TISAX)
 Ensuring ISO 27001 matrix certification for both national and international business units and the relevant Deutsche Telekom Group entities
 Identifying and validating security risks, developing mitigation strategies, and leading related projects
 Planning and implementing security measures to monitor, detect, and prevent cyberattacks
 Collaborating closely with operational Security Managers to ensure consistent security execution
 Qualifications
 University degree with a security or IT focus
 High‑proficiency (C‑level) German language skills
 Several years of practical experience in Information Security
 Solid understanding of relevant security and risk management standards (e.g., ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 27701, TISAX)
 Interest in organizational, administrative, and governance‑related tasks
 Experience in internal or external audits (as lead auditor or co‑auditor)
 Confident use of Microsoft 365 tools, including SharePoint
 Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex security topics clearly
 Effective team player with the ability to collaborate across units and cultures
 Proactive problem‑solver with a structured, solution‑oriented mindset
 Capable of working independently and driving topics autonomously
 Additional Information
 Advantages
 Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security+, CCNA Security
 Practical knowledge of risk management and handling security risks at management level
 AI / automation / data analysis proficiency
 Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

results.descriptionText:
Nálunk ezek a feladatok várnak:
a Szerencsejáték Zrt. fogadási és üzletkritikus informatikai rendszereinek stratégiai és operatív irányítása, fejlesztése és folyamatos működésének biztosítása;az üzleti célokkal összhangban rövid-, közép- és hosszú távú informatikai stratégia és technológiai roadmap kialakítása és végrehajtásának felügyelete;az informatikai szakterület szakmai folyamatainak, működési modelljének és szervezeti struktúrájának alakítása, üzleti elvárásoknak megfelelő fejlesztése;aktív részvétel a vállalat informatikai stratégiájának kialakításában;üzleti céljaink technológiai támogatásának biztosítása;a több millió ügyfél kiszolgálását támogató fogadási rendszereink technológiai fejlesztési irányainak meghatározása és megvalósításának irányítása;informatikai projektek és fejlesztési portfólió teljes körű irányítása, különös tekintettel a digitalizációs és folyamatautomatizálási kezdeményezésekre;fejlesztői-, rendszerintegrációs- és egyéb külső technológiai partnerek szakmai menedzsmentje;aktív részvétel a vállalat stratégiai döntéseiben, valamint a változások és szervezeti fejlesztések támogatása. Te vagy a legalkalmasabb erre a pozícióra, amennyiben:
felsőfokú szakirányú informatikai, műszaki vagy kapcsolódó végzettséggel rendelkezel;legalább 8-10 év releváns informatikai szakmai tapasztalat, amelyből legalább 5 év vezetői tapasztalat komplex IT-szervezet vagy IT-terület irányításában;rendelkezel nagy üzleti jelentőségű informatikai rendszerek fejlesztésében, üzemeltetésében vagy modernizációjában szerzett tapasztalattal;képes vagy az üzleti igényeket technológiai megoldásokká formálni, és az informatikát valódi üzleti partnerként működtetni;határozott döntéshozatal, erős rendszerszemlélet, stratégiai gondolkodás és innovatív megközelítés jellemez;döntéseid során felelősséget vállalsz, és magabiztos vagy változó, komplex üzleti környezetben;munkád során partnerként működsz együtt a szervezet különböző területeivel;aktív angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel. Előnyt jelent:
fogadási, gaming, pénzügyi szolgáltatási, telekommunikációs vagy más magas rendelkezésre állású rendszereket működtető vállalati környezetben szerzett tapasztalat;digitális transzformációs, alkalmazásmodernizációs vagy nagyvállalati rendszerfejlesztési projektek vezetése;komplex adatfeldolgozó, integrációs vagy tranzakciós rendszerek működtetésében szerzett gyakorlat;információbiztonsági, kockázatkezelési vagy üzletmenet-folytonossági területen szerzett tapasztalat;agilis, hibrid vagy nagyvállalati módszertanok ismerete. Ha szeretnél egy nagy múltú, ugyanakkor folyamatosan fejlődő vállalat informatikai működésének meghatározó vezetője lenni, jelentkezz hozzánk, és építsük együtt a Szerencsejáték Zrt. következő fejezetét! Miért érdemes hozzánk csatlakoznod?
 Céginfó
A Szerencsejáték Zrt.-nél a játék, a szórakozás és a nyerés izgalmát nyújtjuk játékosainknak. Ez az élmény és szenvedély nem csak játékosainkat, de munkavállalóinkat is áthatja. Legyél Te is nyertes és lépj be velünk érdekes, élményekkel teli, izgalmas világunkba! A Szerencsejáték Zrt.-nél olyan stratégiai és üzleti szemléletű, inspiráló informatikai vezetőt keresünk, aki képes egyszerre biztosítani az üzletkritikus rendszerek stabil működését, valamint irányítani a vállalat digitális transzformációs és technológiai fejlesztési törekvéseit. Ha motivál, hogy több millió ügyfél kiszolgálását támogató rendszerek jövőjét alakítsd, innovatív megoldásokat vezess be, és a technológiát valódi üzleti partnerként működtesd, várjuk jelentkezésedet. Miért izgalmas ez a lehetőség? Ebben a szerepben a vállalat technológiai jövőjének alakításáért felelsz: az üzletkritikus rendszerek és infrastruktúra irányításától a digitális transzformációs, innovációs és kiberbiztonsági kezdeményezések megvalósításáig. A felsővezetői csapat tagjaként legfontosabb célod, hogy az általad felügyelt és irányított technológia az egyik legfontosabb építő köve legyen a vállalat hosszú távú fejlődésének. Olyan nagy hatású vezetői pozícióról van szó, ahol a stabil működés, a digitális innováció és a stratégiai gondolkodás egyszerre kap meghatározó szerepet. Ez egy kivételes lehetőség arra, hogy formáld Magyarország egyik legismertebb vállalatának technológiai jövőjét.

results.descriptionText:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
 Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
 About The Role
 At Camunda, our CI/CD infrastructure platform is treated as an internal product. Our mission is to build a platform that offers a Golden Path, enabling 150+ engineers across 20+ teams to deliver with world-class velocity and uncompromising quality at scale, that will allow Camunda engineers to focus on building the agentic technologies that will define our market leadership.
We are approaching a pivotal phase: an upcoming quality surge that will significantly increase testing volume and engineering throughput. Our platform must scale seamlessly, without increasing developer toil.
We are looking for an Engineering Manager who acts as a servant leader. You will guide a high-leverage remote team of four infrastructure engineers and drive the evolution toward a scalable zero-toil platform.
At the organizational level, you will ensure that the right way is the easy way, serving as an advocate for the engineers who rely on the platform every day.
If you’re excited about building autonomous, high-leverage platform teams at scale, we’d love to talk!
 What You'll Be Doing
 Ensure we continuously deliver and improve our infrastructure platform
 Guide the team through massive reduction of manual work through employing an AI-driven engineering approach. You will reach a zero-touch scalable infrastructure, where AI handles dependency management, assists with incident resolution, cloud cost optimization, and developer support - ensuring the team can handle increasing scope and scale without having to grow in size.
 Quality surge: You will prepare, define and ensure execution of the strategy for our CI/CD and artifact distribution systems to scale without increasing engineering toil
 Grow, mentor and coach a high-leverage platform team of 4 Infrastructure engineers, by setting clear expectations, giving actionable and timely feedback, and fostering a culture of empathy, autonomy, and continuous improvement, in an asynchronous, remote environment.
 What You Bring
 Ability and/or willingness to use our product.
 People leadership experience: track record of growing engineers to senior and beyond senior levels.
 Strong stakeholder leadership: Ability to translate tech needs into actionable engineering roadmap and strategy, and implement that across teams.
 Senior-level technical depth and competency: Hands-on experience with:
 Cloud providers (e.g., GCP, AWS or similar)
 Kubernetes (any distribution)
 Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, ArgoCD or similar)
 Scaling high-load CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions with self-hosted runners or similar).
 Backend engineering background, fluent in at least one programming language (e.g. Python)
 Comfortable at reviewing complex architecture and code; eager to contribute hands-on when needed (e.g. to implement internal workflow automations)
 Proven track record of ensuring team efficiency within remote, async-first environments
 Nice-to-haves
 Experience transforming teams into AI-native and/or automation-first teams
 Background in technical product management or strong product thinking
 Experience implementing FinOps practices and accountability
 This role is an existing vacancy
 #C1
 Compensation
 What We Have to Offer:
 We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.
 The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:
 United States: $172,600.00 to $278,300.00 
 Canada: C$183,300.00 to C$301,500.00
 United Kingdom: £108,400.00 to £178,300.00 
 Singapore: S$214,400.00 to S$321,500.00
 If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.
 Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) .
 Benefits & Perks
 We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.
 Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
 In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
 Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.
 Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.
 Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!
 AI in our hiring process : Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here
 ”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!
 Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!
 Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @ camunda.com or @ talent.camunda.com . We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.
 Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

results.descriptionText:
Job Description
 It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that. 
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Enterprise Service Manager, Global Delivery Payroll (BAU), this full time position is based in Budapest and offers European coverage.
 Purpose Of Role
 Reporting to the Global Delivery Director – Payroll, the Enterprise Service Manager (ESM) is a strategic and hands-on position responsible for the successful planning, designing and execution of global payroll delivery without friction to Vistra clients.
The ESM role will be responsible for focusing on client retention and growth by ensuring that client payroll services are administered in an accurate and timely manner whilst maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
 Scope
 Manage a portfolio of Tier 1 and Tier 2 clients.
The primary role will require strong client engagement, strong Global Delivery Knowledge and understanding, internal stakeholder management and strong communication skills across many differing cultures.
The role will require a strong background in Global Payroll Delivery. Understanding how to develop and implement Global Standards that ensures both delivery resilience and managing risk mitigation strategies when issue arise.
In times of ‘Crisis’ this role will become the Single point of contact for both internal and client stakeholders. So a ‘cool head’ under pressure is necessary to assist in local recovery of underperformance whilst providing client communication of resolution activity and next steps.
 Key Responsibilities
 The Global Delivery team manages and facilitates the international expansion of our clients into the UK and globally, providing accounting, HR, payroll and tax solutions to businesses operating in the new markets, leveraging our 85 Vistra offices, alliance partners and other professionals around the world. As the single point of operational accountability across the Vistra group for the client relationship and service delivery, our team has expertise in supporting fast growing businesses.
Our brand brings together our unique skills, talents, and capabilities to create a promise and to deliver an outstanding experience for our clients. It’s how our brand on the inside underpins everything our clients experience on the outside.
The enterprise service manager will work with the enterprise account manager and will be responsible for three key activities:
 Operational service management.
 Account governance.
 Relationship management & client communications.
 Executing our Service Management Framework, the ESM will be responsible for driving account and relationship governance, facilitating client & account team meetings, managing account communications and maintaining account plans, delivering excellent client service across multiple accounts, whilst collaborating with internal stakeholders to support opportunity management, helping our clients achieve progress without friction.
The ESM role will also be responsible in supporting the various payroll teams across Vistra to ensure all global payrolls are managed under GPS model and services. It is expected the role will build and maintain constructive relationships with all stakeholders, including local payroll staff and leadership, GCS/GPS team in and other internal and external customers.
 This Role Brings a Broad Range Of Key Responsibilities
 Orchestrate Service Excellence, understand & align to client strategies & challenges:
 Drive account retention through excellent client service, collaborate with the Enterprise Account Team.
 During client service interactions, identify new opportunities by connecting client needs to additional solutions offered by the organization, collaboratively engaging with Enterprise Account Team to ensure follow up and ultimate account growth.
 Own the service quality process for agreed portfolio of accounts, conducting client interviews with account team members.
 Drive Vistra’s Strategic Account Plan, Advance Revenue Growth and Achieve Retention:
 Coordinate ongoing delivery governance.
 Support Commercial Onboarding, service providers and operational resources to ensure a frictionless client experience.
 Maintaining risk and compliance standards in client portfolio, in collaboration with compliance team
 Facilitate & coordinate regular account meetings with the account team, from agenda to objectives.
 Maintain clear communications with client including leading quarterly business reviews with clients.
 When required support account RFP’s engaging with internal stakeholders.
 Grow & Maintain High Impact Relationship, Teaming & Personal Growth:
 Effectively build formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the client and Vistra organization.
 Serve as the central point of contact & communications for the broader account team, service markets, affiliates & the Global Service Centre, located in Mumbai, to facilitate strong account governance, swift service resolution, whilst developing relationships with regional teams.
 Create & share regular team newsletter (weekly /monthly) related to the account, that consolidates recent & relevant news, announcements, account data, relationships updates and performance metrics.
 Work with the team to create and maintain relationship map, client meeting calendar, value scorecard to drive consistent interaction
 Demonstrate teaming through mentoring & onboarding new members of the community.
 Attributes / Technical Skills
 Ability to gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity
 Self-motivated, with excellent communication and client management skills
 Quickly able to build relationships and gain trust of clients
 An expert at creative problem-solving
 Basic Project Management skills
 Strong team player that embraces international collaboration
 Able to prioritise and ensure agreed timelines are adhered to
 Ability to identify issues and bring in experts to solve client issues
 Make sense of complex, high quality, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems by engaging experts as needed
 Must be capable of managing service providers, to ensure value for money
 Competent with MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word)
 Relevant Experience
 Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management or a related field
 Ideally 5+ years of payroll / HR experience working in a client-facing environment, with a good track record of delivering against client requests.
 Ideally 5+ years of experience in an operations related environment, with a prove ability to deliver cost effective solutions and service design
 Proven experience in operational and client management
 Experience in handling complex client discussions
 Proven ability to repair & improve client relationships
 What We Offer
 25 days holiday
 Bonus scheme
 Insurance
 Hybrid working
 If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

results.descriptionText:
About Liferay
 Liferay is a uniquely profitable B2B enterprise software company with 1,000+ fiery-eyed employees all across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. As a renowned provider of enterprise open source technologies, we have been recognized by Gartner for empowering businesses around the world to solve complex digital challenges. Liferay’s all-in-one platform unites Liferay DXP with our cloud platform capabilities, built-in analytics, and commerce functionality, reducing time to market and accelerating innovation. Our customer roster includes global companies such as Airbus, US Bank, Honda, and Desjardins.
But we don’t just make awesome software, we are also fueled by a greater-than-profit vision. By building a vibrant business, making technology useful, and investing in communities, we make it possible for people to reach their full potential to serve others. This commitment extends beyond our product; Liferay donates 10% of our profits to charities around the world. Oh, we’re also self-funded which gives us the freedom to work on whatever we think brings the most value to customers and communities in the long run!
 About You And This Role
 The Security Operations Manager is a strategic leader responsible for managing the Security Operations team and ensuring its alignment with organizational objectives. The role encompasses oversight of policies and procedures, performance tracking, and collaboration with cross-departmental leaders to ensure effective incident response and proactive security measures.
 Responsibilities
 Team Leadership: Lead and direct the Security Operations team, providing guidance and oversight to ensure optimal performance.
 Policy Administration: Administer and improve established processes for handling security alerts, incident response, and vulnerability management.
 Strategic Planning: Contribute to departmental budgeting, strategic planning, and procedural changes to enhance security operations.
 Technology Leadership: Work with the team or other departments to reduce the chance of incidents happening.
 Delegation, transfer of tasks: Ensure management of the frequent incident types are delegated to the NOC / 24/7 incident management teams. This includes training and automating work for those teams.
 Championing AI: Following developments in AI models and tools and training the team to deploy them to speed up investigations and reduce work.
 Incident Management: Oversee the management of security incidents, escalating and coordinating with senior leadership and other departments as needed.

results.descriptionText:
Discover your impact with KUKA Group KUKA Group offers an enormous spectrum of possibilities to advance your career, live your passions and unlock your potential. We´re one of the world's leading automation specialists, offering global opportunities in areas such as robotics, automation, logistics, software solutions and electronics. If you´re a go-getter, a visionary with bold ambitions and believer in collaboration and mutual respect, then you're poised for success here at KUKA Group.
 Responsibilities
 Make an impact
 Coordinates the planning, the management and the execution of multiple projects
 Supports the Portfolio Management in the optimization of the overall resource use and in ensuring programs and projects continue to meet the overall strategic objectives and deliver expected business outcomes and benefits
 Supports the Project Portfolio governance body
 Develops Project Management skills within the IT organization through training and coaching/mentoring
 Owns the program and project management frameworks, templates and procedures; is responsible for ensuring they are fit for purpose and continue to be best practice; advises on tailoring templates and procedures to achieve appropriate project structure
 Selects, implements, owns and supports PPM tools
 Support adoption of project and program management processes; advises on the available standards, procedures, methods, tools and techniques
 Conducts reviews and audits of projects and programs to ensure quality of deliverables and conformance to defined PM standards, recommends changes where necessary
 Performs centralized project and program performance tracking and reporting
 IT resource planning to ensure optimal allocation and utilization across all initiatives
 Budget planning and controlling of all initiatives
 Application Requirements
 What you need to succeed
 Bachelor or master degree in business administration or business informatics or comparable education
 Proven experience in managing IT projects and/or Portfolio Management
 Demonstrated experience managing and coordinating multiple concurrent projects and programs
 Background in resource planning, budget planning, and financial controlling across initiatives
 Strong experience in project and program performance tracking, KPI definition, and reporting
 Strong decision making, analytical and problem solving skills
 Experience with PPM tools (selection, implementation, ownership, and ongoing support)
 Proven experience supporting portfolio governance bodies and senior decision-makers
 High level of communication and assertiveness
 Agile mindset, willingness to learn and open-mindedness towards change
 Good knowledge of M365 and relevant project management tools
 Good English language skills, both written and spoken
 We are looking for an enthusiastic and assertive type of person who enjoys working in a team within an international environment. You communicate openly and effectively with all groups and levels.
 13th salary
Bilingual work environment
Cafeteria
Company shuttle bus
Employee Assistance Program
Hybrid working
 DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) statement 
 Our core belief is in treating each other with kindness, an open mind, and mutual respect, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.
KUKA Group is a company committed to equal opportunities. We manage every application with meticulous care and consideration - with a decision-making process that pays no heed to your origin, educational background, age, gender, sexual orientation, or your religious or political beliefs. If you join KUKA Group, you will have ample opportunities to share what motivates you and what defines your individuality.
 Join the journey!
 If you think a career with KUKA Group could be what you are looking for, we´d love to hear from you. We´re looking forward to receiving your application!
